title: On-demand view spec — the living chart contract
description: The artifact between a query and its pixels, for ON-DEMAND generated charts. Three parts: query (the DSL query_task currently backing the view), envelope (the NAVIGABLE SPACE — facts, dims with drill edges, grains — derived by CODE from the query + catalog, never free-typed), and view (the current presentation, chosen by the representation rules in rules/representation-rules.json — first match wins, deterministic). Every user interaction (drill, pivot, regrain, rerange, compare) is a deterministic transformation of `query` per rules/interactions.json, CONTAINED to the envelope — nothing outside the declared dims/facts/grains is reachable, and no LLM runs at interaction time. Ambiguity gets a fast default, never a question: a wrong first view costs one click because the chart itself is the correction mechanism. Pinning snapshots the CURRENT state into a card-definition (ad-dashboards-prebuilt), so generated charts join the same pin/unpin lifecycle as the prebuilt library.

title.description: short chart title; the user's phrasing, cleaned

query.description: The query currently backing the view. Interactions REPLACE this with a transformed copy (rules/interactions.json); the executor is the same one endpoint that serves prebuilt cards.

pin.description: Generated charts are pinnable like prebuilt ones: pinning writes a card-definition (ad-dashboards-prebuilt schema) carrying the CURRENT query + view — a chart the user pivoted into shape keeps that shape as a standing card.

envelope.description: The navigable space. DERIVED BY CODE (generator/derive.py) from the query + catalog: facts from canonical metric keys (primitives.yaml metric_sources), dims from DM/bronze dimension keys with drill edges from rules/drill-graph.json, grains from the gold day-grain rollup rule. The LLM never authors this.

additive.description: false for ratios/uniques (roas, reach) — non-additive facts never stack, never marimekko-size, never blend across platforms

kind.description: stage dims (funnel steps) enable sankey; cohort dims (first-order period) enable cohort_matrix

cardinality.description: low <= ~6 known members (placement, device, os) -> vertical bars; high (campaigns, products, keywords) -> ranked horizontal bars

drill_to.description: dims reachable by clicking a member of THIS dim (rules/drill-graph.json edges); drill = where-predicate on the clicked value + swap to the target dim

grains.description: gold stores day; week/month are date_trunc at read

view.description: Current presentation state. representation comes from rules/representation-rules.json (first match wins — same data shape ALWAYS gets the same chart; never varied for variety). x/series/cell reference envelope dim keys or a grain; y references envelope fact keys. Max 2 facts on any chart except table.

intent.description: the analytical ask. When the prompt is ambiguous the generator defaults (comparison for a categorical dim, trend for time) and moves on — no clarifying question, ever

representation.description: NO pie, NO area: spatial-area comparisons are banned by the ruleset

x.description: dim key or grain on the x axis (line: a grain; bars: the category dim; heatmap: column dim; marimekko: width dim; sankey: source stage; cohort_matrix: cohort dim)

y.description: fact key(s). Two facts only when units are compatible or a dual axis is explicit; tables are exempt from the cap

series.description: split dim (line: one line per member; bars: grouped; heatmap: row dim; marimekko: height dim; sankey: target stage; cohort_matrix: the age grain)

compare.description: vs previous period (dashed grey). Defaults ON for kpi and trend — numbers never render without comparative context

share.description: render the additive fact as % of the visible total alongside absolute (composition intent); ONLY on additive facts

interaction.description: A user gesture on the chart, recorded and applied as a query/view transformation per rules/interactions.json. The server validates the transformed query against the envelope before executing: an interaction that leaves the envelope is rejected.

value.description: clicked member (drill): becomes a where eq predicate

to.description: target dim/fact/grain key — must exist in the envelope
